data.long_meaning: The name Vasav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vasu', which means 'to dwell'. The name is associated with the Vasus, a group of deities in Hindu mythology. The name Vasav is also considered to be the name of Indra, the king of the gods in Hinduism. The name is believed to confer power, prosperity, and victory. The name Vasav carries the meaning “King of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vasav usually hope their child will grow to embody king of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
